fixtureDescriptions.realPath: 96-task acyclic mixed-relation graph; root capacity 8; no standalone graph/state is instantiated.
fixtureDescriptions.prototype: 256-task deterministic DAG with 16-task layers; root capacity 8.
fixtureDescriptions.highFanout: one root plus 255 direct dependents; root settles unsatisfied before catalog/validation.
fixtureDescriptions.branchSearch: a binary-ready selection tree to depth 7; retained DFS/BFS frontier is intentionally kept live for heap observation.
fixtureDescriptions.implementationFixedDepth: a shipped public state after eight select/settle successors; setup is separately timed before reusable inspection, warm catalog, and repeated-validation target rows.

measurement.allocation: heapUsed delta around each batch without forced GC; proxy only
measurement.implementationTargetOperations: fixed-depth setup is measured separately; inspection, warm catalog, repeated validation, and high-fanout reuse prebuilt immutable states
measurement.retainedHeap: Bun.gc(true) before/after live retained branches when available; process-wide advisory observation
